# Orbuni

> Orbuni is a university search and application platform based in Istanbul, Türkiye. International students, mainly from Africa, the Middle East and Asia, use it to compare 2,600+ programmes at 48 partner universities in Türkiye, Northern Cyprus, the UAE, Germany, Egypt and Russia, apply free with a dedicated counsellor, and get support with scholarships, admission, visa preparation, student housing and arrival. Tuition is always paid directly to the university.

Key facts:
- Based in Istanbul, Türkiye. Applications are submitted through official university partner channels.
- 2,698 programmes, 48 partner universities, 6 countries.
- Searching, comparing and applying is free, with a dedicated counsellor and a private student portal.
- Website: https://myorbuni.com · WhatsApp: +1 443 448 1577 · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/myorbuni

What every student gets, free:
- Search 2,600+ programmes: Tuition and the current scholarship side by side, at 48 partner universities in six countries.
- A dedicated counsellor: One person who knows your file, from your first question to your first lecture.
- Scholarship matching: We apply for the highest scholarship band your grades qualify for.
- Your application, done properly: Every document checked, then submitted through official university partner channels.
- Your student portal: Every document, update and offer letter in one private place.
- Housing, visa and arrival support: Real residences chosen before you fly, a checked visa file, and help when you land.

## Questions and answers
- Does it cost anything to apply through Orbuni? No. Searching, comparing and applying through Orbuni is free, with a dedicated counsellor.
- What does Orbuni do? Orbuni is a university search and application platform based in Istanbul, Türkiye. Students compare 2,600+ programmes at 48 partner universities in Türkiye, Northern Cyprus, the UAE, Germany, Egypt and Russia, apply free, and get support with scholarships, admission, visa preparation, student housing and arrival.
- Do I pay my tuition to Orbuni? No. Tuition and university deposits are paid directly to the university's own account, never to Orbuni. You get the university's receipt.
- How do I know Orbuni is genuine? Orbuni is based in Istanbul and submits applications through official university partner channels. Applying is free, any payment happens only on secure myorbuni.com checkout pages, tuition goes straight to the university, and documents are uploaded to your private portal, never sent over WhatsApp. See about Orbuni.
- Can Orbuni help me get a scholarship? Yes. Most private universities in Türkiye give international students a tuition scholarship of 25% to 100%. We match your grades to each university's scholarship bands and apply for the highest band you qualify for. See how Turkish scholarships work.
- What is a "scholarship" at a Turkish private university? Usually a discount on tuition that the university gives international students. Its size depends on the university, the programme and sometimes your grades. It is different from the Turkish government scholarship (Türkiye Bursları).
- Which documents do I need to apply? Usually your passport, your secondary school certificate (for example WAEC, NECO, KCSE or your country's equivalent), your transcript and a photograph. Some programmes ask for an English test. You upload them to your Orbuni portal.
- Do I need IELTS to study in Türkiye? Not always. Many universities accept their own English test or proof of English-medium schooling. See do you need IELTS?.
- Does Orbuni help with the student visa? Yes. We prepare and check your visa file with you: what to bring, how to present it and what the consulate looks for. If a visa is refused, your file can be carried over to the next intake.
- Can Orbuni help with housing in Istanbul? Yes. Orbuni shows real student residences with photos and prices, and you choose before you fly. See student housing.
- Which countries does Orbuni place students in? Türkiye, Northern Cyprus, the UAE, Germany, Egypt and Russia.
- Who does Orbuni work with? Students and parents from Africa, the Middle East, Asia and Europe, and partner education agencies who refer students.
- How fast will someone answer me? The WhatsApp assistant answers at any hour, and a counsellor replies in working hours (Istanbul time).
- How do I start? Take the free 2-minute assessment at myorbuni.com/#start. It shows which universities and scholarships fit your grades, budget, documents and timeline.
